title: Chale aao baba
body:
Chale aao baba
(Chale Aao Baba, Chale Aao Baba, Chale Aao Baba) x2
Sunaati Hai Mujhko Phuphijaan Kahaani, Karun Kya Magar Neend Aati Nahin Hai
<<MINI>>
(Chale Aao Baba, Chale Aao Baba, Mujhe Khaak Par Neend Aati Nahi Hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaleje Mai Uthta Hai Ik Dard Aisa, Ke Jiske Liye Na Dawaa Na Dilaasa
Mai Kal Tak Toh Sine Pe Soti Thi Baba, Yehi Soch Kar, Neend Aati NAhin Hai
<<MINI>>
(Chale Aao Baba, Chale Aao Baba, Mujhe Khaak Par Neend Aati Nahi Hai) x 2
<<DIVIDER>>
Huwaa Kyun Na Jaane Sitamgar Zamaana, Kabhi Gurkhiyan De Kabhi Taziyana
Yehi Khauf Hai Jo Satata Hai Mujhko, Issi Baat Par, Neend Aati Nahin Hai
<<MINI>>
(Chale Aao Baba, Chale Aao Baba, Mujhe Khaak Par Neend Aati Nahi Hai) x 2
<<DIVIDER>>
Rulaati Hai Mujhko Laeenon Ki Baatein, Guzarti Hai Aise Yateemi Ki Raatein
Kahin Shimr Aakar Tamaache Na Maare, Hai Dil Mai Yeh Dar, Neend Aati Nahin Hai
<<MINI>>
(Chale Aao Baba, Chale Aao Baba, Mujhe Khaak Par Neend Aati Nahi Hai) x 2
<<DIVIDER>>
Khabar Hai Yeh Mujhko Khataa Meri Kya Hai, Yehi Na Ke Jadd Mera Mushkil Kusha Hai
Sunaaye Woh Mushkil Kusha Mujhko Lori, Unhe Do Khabar, Neend Aati Nahin Hai
<<MINI>>
(Chale Aao Baba, Chale Aao Baba, Mujhe Khaak Par Neend Aati Nahi Hai) x 2
<<DIVIDER>>
Yateemi Ka Ehsaas Hii Ik Sitam Hai, Musalsal Tarapne Se Hoton Pe Gham Hai
Agar Ab Yeh Zindaan Hii Ghar Hai Mera, Chale Aao Ghar, Neend Aati Nahin Hai
<<MINI>>
(Chale Aao Baba, Chale Aao Baba, Mujhe Khaak Par Neend Aati Nahi Hai) x 2
<<DIVIDER>>
Kabhi Maine Socha Nahin Tha Yeh Baba, Ke Tumse Bichhadkar Bhi Jeena Padhega
Tumhaare Bina Hii Mujhe Ab Hai Jeena, Yehi Jaankar, Neend Aati Nahin Hai
<<MINI>>
(Chale Aao Baba, Chale Aao Baba, Mujhe Khaak Par Neend Aati Nahi Hai) x 2
<<DIVIDER>>
Phuphi Jaa(n) Se Aksar Suna Hai Yeh Nauha, Tadapta Hai Ban Mai Shah-e-dee(n) Ka Laasha
Mere Paas Aajaao Maqtal Se Baba, Tumhe Bhi Agar, Neend Aati Nahin Hai
<<MINI>>
(Chale Aao Baba, Chale Aao Baba, Mujhe Khaak Par Neend Aati Nahi Hai) x 2
<<DIVIDER>>
Masaaeb Ne Yeh Haal Sab Ka Kiya Hai, Ke Din Raat Matam Hai Aaho Bukaa Hai
Phuphi Ho Ke Sajjad Ho Ya Sakina, Kisi Ko Idhar, Neend Aati Nahin Hai
<<MINI>>
(Chale Aao Baba, Chale Aao Baba, Mujhe Khaak Par Neend Aati Nahi Hai) x 2
<<DIVIDER>>
Yeh Irfan-o-Mazhar Ke Dil Ki Sadaa Hai, Jaha Shahzadi Ka Madfann Banaa Hai
Hai Jisne Bhi Dekha Sitam Ka Wo Zindaan, Usse Umr Bhar, Neend Aati Nahin Hai
<<MINI>>
(Chale Aao Baba, Chale Aao Baba, Mujhe Khaak Par Neend Aati Nahi Hai) x2
